fields.Name: Member Event Attendance
fields.Description: One row per valid event registration by a member: who registered, which event (the annual conference or a workshop, with its year), and whether they attended. Built from Event Order Lines on Confirmed orders, excluding refunds and refunded orders. The attendee is the line's PersonID, not the person billed. The real event comes from the order number (…-EVT-<year>-<code>), because all years share two event products. AttendanceOutcome is Attended / No Show / Cancelled when recorded, Upcoming for future events, and Not Recorded for past workshops, which were never closed out. Attended is 1 or 0.
fields.TechnicalDescription:
## Overview

Tracks member event attendance across annual conferences and workshops, including attendee email contact information. Links confirmed order lines to event product details, member profiles, and person records to determine attendance status, derived event metadata, contact details, and outcomes.

## Query Logic

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Event Order Lines] -->|join| B[Order Lines & Headers]
    A -->|join| C[Products & Event Products]
    A -->|join| D[People Contact Info]
    A -->|join| E[Member Profiles]
    B -->|filter| F[Confirmed & Non-Reversed Orders]
    C -->|filter| G[Event Products Only]
    D -->|include| H[Name & Email]
    E -->|include| I[Member Number, Region & Segment]
    F --> J[Parse Event Metadata & Attendance Outcomes]
    G --> J
    H --> J
    I --> J
    J --> K[Sort by Event Year & Registration Date]
```

## Data Sources

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Event Order Lines (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwEventOrderLines`)
- **ID** — Primary key linking to base order line
- **PersonID** — Attendee identifier
- **TicketTier** — Tier of event registration ticket
- **AttendanceStatus** — Recorded attendance state

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Lines (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderLines`)
- **ID** — Order line primary key
- **OrderHeaderID** — Foreign key to header
- **ProductID** — Product registered for
- **ReversesOrderLineID** — Used to filter reversal records

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Headers (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderHeaders`)
- **ID** — Order header primary key
- **OrderNumber** — Encodes event year and code
- **OrderDate** — Registration order timestamp
- **Status** — Must be 'Confirmed'
- **ReversesOrderHeaderID** — Used to filter reversal records

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Products (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwProducts`)
- **ID** — Product primary key
- **Name** — Name of product

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Event Products (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwEventProducts`)
- **ID** — Event product extension primary key
- **EventStartsAt** — Start timestamp of event
- **EventFormat** — Format (In-Person / Virtual)
- **VenueName** — Venue where event is held

### MJ_BizApps_Common: People (`[__mj_BizAppsCommon].vwPeople`)
- **ID** — Person record primary key
- **DisplayName** — Full name of the attendee
- **Email** — Primary email address of the attendee

### MoreCheese: Member Profiles (`[morecheese_members].vwMemberProfiles`)
- **ID** — Member profile primary key
- **PersonID** — Links profile to person
- **MemberNumber** — Human-readable member code
- **Region** — Member geographic region
- **Segment** — Member segment classification

## Relationships

```mermaid
erDiagram
    EventOrderLines ||--|| OrderLines : "is extension of"
    OrderLines }o--|| OrderHeaders : "belongs to"
    OrderLines }o--|| Products : "purchases"
    Products ||--o| EventProducts : "event detail"
    EventOrderLines }o--|| People : "attendee"
    People ||--o| MemberProfiles : "member profile"
```

## Filters & Conditions
- Order header status must be 'Confirmed'
- Order header must not reverse another header (`ReversesOrderHeaderID IS NULL`)
- Order line must not reverse another line (`ReversesOrderLineID IS NULL`)
- Order header must not have a confirmed reversal header against it
- Registration must be for an event product (`INNER JOIN vwEventProducts` drops non-event products)
